race.comment: OUR VINNY (3) returned from a four-month spell last start in a BM64 over this course and distance and did a fair job to finish fourth after racing on the pace. Sure to take a lot from that hit-out and there is a lot of room for improvement at just his fourth race start. LEGO MASTER (4) won his maiden first-up over this distance at the Illawarra Grange circuit and has subsequently struggled in a couple of 1400m contests. Given a six-week let-up which is a nice way to come into this shorter race. Can bounce back. FITZCLARENCE (2) last appeared when successful in a 1300m Hawkesbury maiden in May. Progressed nicely through his maiden prep and should kick on this time in work. SHUDA KNOWN (8) started even money and recorded a comfortable maiden win when resuming over 1100m at Scone last start. Drops sharply in the weights so this step up in grade looks within reach. OUR NOBLE BOY (6) failed to run on over 1100m at Hawkesbury last time but might be worth another chance out to this trip.
